Explore a large open valley with distinct regions, meet characters, follow a multi-chapter story, choose a trail companion, encounter and befriend wild creatures, and manage your party and supplies. **Assumption:** I used original creatures and story rather than Pokémon characters or assets. I checked the game in Chromium; the browser’s bundled Playwright installation was unavailable, so I captured a screenshot using system Chromium instead.
